title: Data catalog & governance — Secoda vs Atlan vs Collibra

companies.name: Secoda
companies.note: AI platform for data and analytics

capabilities.name: Natural-language / AI search
capabilities.description: Ask for data in plain language rather than by table name.

Secoda.note: AI-powered search across the stack with owners and usage

Atlan.note: Conversational search in the Data Marketplace via AI Copilot

Collibra.note: Faceted catalog search; AI assist is newer

capabilities.name: Automated metadata ingestion
capabilities.description: Pull technical metadata from sources without manual entry.

Secoda.note: No-code integrations, automated schema and metadata ingestion

Atlan.note: 80+ connectors feed the Enterprise Data Graph

Collibra.note: Catalog connects to cloud platforms, databases and BI tools

capabilities.name: Browser extension
capabilities.description: Surface catalog context inside other web tools.

Secoda.note: Chrome extension for in-browser discovery and metadata editing

Atlan.note: Everywhere extension surfaces context in Salesforce, Tableau and more

capabilities.name: Role-based access control
capabilities.description: Grant data access by role, team or domain.

Secoda.note: Granular RBAC with custom roles per team

Atlan.note: Classification-driven, domain-aware policies enforced at discovery

Collibra.note: Role- and responsibility-based access with a governance operating model

capabilities.name: Prebuilt compliance policies
capabilities.description: Templates for GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA and similar regimes.

Secoda.note: Built-in GDPR and HIPAA policy templates applied across the stack

Atlan.note: Policy framework plus a dedicated Data Privacy product

Collibra.note: Automated compliance checks and audit-ready policy views
